name: Hydrated terrace Pb(H)2 formation: matched-water precursor
scientific_question: Does the X21-like Pb(H)2 local motif remain stable when placed in the X90 water environment?

jobs.purpose: Test whether a terrace Pb(H)2-like precursor is a local minimum in the hydration environment of the independently optimized on-top two-H reactant X90.
